description.value:
A weapon is perhaps the simplest piece of regalia in terms of symbolism: no matter how ornate it is, it is a tool of war that shows that you are willing to slay others for your court.

Edicts Execute those who pose a threat to your court when imprisoning them could lead to further danger.

Anathema Flee from a fight you could reasonably win.

Regalia's Gift Your weapon is more powerful than others of its kind. Increase its damage die size by one step, to a maximum of d12.

Pick your regalia's weapon type (such as longsword or mace) from the Regalia Weapon dropdown on your Actions tab. Change it whenever you take up a new regalia weapon. Weapons of that type get the larger damage die.
